name: mori-companion-ai
description: Privacy-first local AI companion with a sandboxed Electron desktop pet.
author: Amadeus Local Companion Contributors

scripts.make:desktop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-electron-zip.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-squirrel-vendor.ps1 && electron-forge make
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check lib/demo-reply.js && node --check lib/desktop-pet-action-policy.js && node --check lib/desktop-pet-output-validator.js && node --check lib/evaluation-input-risk.js && node --check lib/evaluation-review-store.js && node --check lib/evaluation-service.js && node --check lib/style-retrieval.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/desktop-pet.js && node --check public/evaluation.js && node --check public/reply-policy.js && node --check public/status-view.js && node --check public/desktop-pet-bootstrap.js && node --check public/desktop-pet-entry.js && node --check public/game-session-policy.js && node --check scripts/launch-desktop.cjs && node --check scripts/test-launch-desktop.cjs && node --check scripts/audit-electron-package.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/diagnostics.cjs && node --check electron/file-trash-service.cjs && node --check electron/package-boundary.cjs && node --check electron/pet-roam.cjs && node --check electron/server-runtime.cjs && node --check electron/window-source-pager.cjs && node --check electron/preload-host.cjs && node --check electron/preload-pet.cjs && node --check forge.config.cjs && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:safety && npm run test:profile && npm run test:conversation && npm run test:media && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:evaluation && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:release && node scripts/test-launch-desktop.cjs
scripts.test:evaluation: node --test tests/desktop-pet-action-policy.test.js tests/desktop-pet-output-validator.test.js tests/evaluation-input-risk.test.js tests/evaluation-service.test.js tests/evaluation-review-store.test.js tests/evaluation-api.test.js tests/evaluation-ui-contract.test.js
scripts.test:desktop: node --test tests/desktop-pet-assets.test.js tests/electron-edge-state.test.cjs tests/electron-file-trash.test.cjs tests/electron-host-preload.test.cjs tests/electron-pet-roam.test.cjs tests/final-pet-regression-contract.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && python scripts/test_character_corpus.py && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:pet
